title: Jerawat ambil masa berapa lama untuk terbentuk?
topic: Acne formation + soothing a painful red pimple
source: Creator reference video (English podcast clip): acne can take ~90 days to form; ice helps calm painful, inflamed pimples.
fact_check: Acne starts as a microcomedone: a pore/follicle blocked by excess sebum and dead skin cells, forming under the skin before anything is visible (AAD; Thiboutot & Zaenglein, J Am Acad Dermatol).

The process from microcomedone to a visible pimple is commonly described as taking weeks up to around 2–3 months; the '90 days' figure from the reference is presented as 'boleh ambil masa sampai lebih kurang 90 hari' (up to ~90 days), not as an exact rule.
Four drivers: excess oil (sebum), dead skin cells clogging the pore, C. acnes bacteria multiplying, and inflammation (AAD).
A cold compress (ice wrapped in a cloth, briefly) can temporarily reduce swelling, redness and pain of an inflamed pimple; it does not cure acne. Never apply ice directly for long.
Severe or persistent acne should be seen by a doctor/dermatologist. Nadia is a skincare educator, not a medical professional.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Eh Nadia, you tahu tak, I ingat jerawat ni tiba-tiba je naik overnight.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Actually tak, Maya. Jerawat tu dah mula terbentuk bawah kulit, lama sebelum kita nampak.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Boleh ambil masa sampai lebih kurang sembilan puluh hari.
lines.display: Boleh ambil masa sampai lebih kurang 90 hari.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Sembilan puluh hari? Macam mana boleh jadi?

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Pori tersumbat dengan minyak dan sel kulit mati. Lepas tu bakteria membiak, kulit jadi meradang, baru jerawat naik.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Ohh, so masa kita nampak tu, benda tu dah lama jadi la.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Betul. Kalau jerawat merah yang sakit, cuba tuam ais yang dibalut kain, sekejap je. Boleh bantu kurangkan bengkak.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Tapi kalau jerawat teruk, jumpa doktor ya.

infographics.label: Bawah kulit → nampak di permukaan (sampai ~90 hari)
